name: Position size calculator
summary: Compute a share/unit count from account capital, percent risked, entry, and stop — no order is sent.
author: friday-core
description: Informational analysis, education, or calculation only. FRIDAY has no brokerage or exchange connection and cannot place, execute, or automate a real trade. Uses riskAmount = capital × riskPct/100 and size = floor(riskAmount / |entry − stop|). Output is a number for study, not a live ticket.
